## What changed

- When a check fails in the Action, the job log now links to the run's summary page. (`action-failure-points-to-summary`)
- A draft decision no longer holds back the summary. (#76)

## Other changes

- chore: merging main
- Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.17.1...v0.18.0
